gloss_en: 'Bereishit' — the first word of the Torah understood as a supernal divine utterance: in LM I:22 the complete utterance (maamar hashalem), aspect of 'before creation', the heard/Nishma and hidden dimension; in LM II:12 the same word as the sealed/hidden utterance (maamar satum) from which vitality flows even to the lowest places. Not the book of Genesis as a text, nor the plain temporal sense 'in the beginning'.
